text: uṣasīṃ caiva gāyatrīṃ sāvitrīṃ ca sarasvatīm / vedānāṃ mātaraṃ pṛthvīmajāṃ caiva tu kauśikīm // 11.17.29 //
html:
uṣasīṃ caiva gāyatrīṃ sāvitrīṃ ca sarasvatīm

author: śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca

text: sāṇkṛtiṃ vai sārvajitiṃ gāyatrīṃ tarpaṇe vadet / tarpaṇānte ca śāntyarthaṃ jātavedasamīrayet // 11.17.30 //

author: śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca

text: mānastoketi mantraṃ ca śāntyarthaṃ prajapetsudhīḥ / tato'pi tryambako mantraḥ śāntyarthaḥ parikīrtitaḥ // 11.17.31 //

author: śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca

text: tacchaṃyoriti mantraṃ ca japecchāntyarthameva tu / ato devā iti dvābhyāṃ sarvāṇgasparśanaṃ caret // 11.17.32 //

text: evaṃ vidhānaṃ sandhyāyāḥ prātaḥkāle prakīrtitam / sandhyākarma samāpyānte'pyagnihotraṃ svayaṃ hunet // 11.17.34 //

text: pancāyatanapūjāṃ ca tataḥ kuryātsamāhitaḥ / śivāṃ śivaṃ gaṇapatiṃ sūryaṃ viṣṇuṃ tathārcayet // 11.17.35 //

author: śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca

text: pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena vyāhṛtyā vā samāhitaḥ / mūlamantreṇa vā kuryāddhrīśca te iti mantrataḥ // 11.17.36 //

text: bhavānīṃ tu yajenmadhye tathaiśānyāṃ tu mādhavam / āgneyyāṃ girijānāthaṃ gaṇeśaṃ rakṣasāṃ diśi // 11.17.37 //
